subject: POC success metrics matrix and ownership tether
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC success metrics matrix and ownership tether

Hi Lena / Amit —

Thanks again for a productive discovery session this morning. I wanted to capture a concise post-call recap, proposed success metrics matrix for the 4-week evaluation, and the immediate next steps to keep momentum. Please review and confirm or flag edits by EOD Monday so we can lock owners and kickoff tasks early next week.

Summary of outcomes from today
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note summarization + triage routing for priority cases.
- Evaluation window requested: 4 weeks with production-like datasets & 2-week decision window.
- Key constraint: PHI-handling and regional data residency for EU patients (noted for subset of records).

Proposed success metrics (initial matrix — attached as spreadsheet)
1) Accuracy / quality
  - Topline: mean ROUGE/L, and human acceptance rate >= 85% for prioritized notes.
  - Owner: Aurum data reviewer + Redwood eval (Marissa).
2) Latency
  - P95 generation <= 300ms for 1k-token window (baseline run attached).
  - Owner: Aurum infra / Redwood ops (Ben).
3) Cost efficiency
  - Per-inference token cost target (TBD during kickoff; target to be set week 1).
  - Owner: Aurum finance + Redwood sales (Olga).
4) Stability / error rate
  - API error rate < 0.5% over continuous runs; automated fallbacks enabled.
  - Owner: Redwood engineering (Ben).

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): confirm success matrix, security checklist, and E2E access (sample dataset + temp creds). Action: Aurum to deliver 1k sample records by 3/15.
- Week 1: ingest + baseline runs (latency + accuracy), surface initial gaps.
- Week 2: tuning (prompt templates, batching configs, caching).
- Week 3: production-mimic runs & human review cadence.
- Week 4: final readout and decision window.

Immediate asks / action owners
- Aurum: share anonymized sample (1k records) and confirm data residency constraints (Amit / Lena) — due 2027-03-15.
- Redwood: provide SOC2 summary & network checklist for security review (attached) — owner: Olga.
- Redwood Ops: schedule baseline latency run upon sample receipt — owner: Ben.
- Evaluation owner: Marissa to run human acceptance checks and compile rubric.

Attachments: success-metrics-matrix.xlsx, network-checklist.pdf

If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff (technical) and a recurring Tuesday 10:00am PT 30-min status for the duration of the trial.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aurumhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success metrics matrix and ownership tether

Thanks, Olga — very clear, appreciated. Quick responses inline: 

- Success metrics: the accuracy targets look reasonable. We will run the human acceptance rubric internally; Marissa, if you want additional context I can loop in a clinician reviewer.
- Latency: 300ms P95 is ambitious but acceptable as the initial target — we can relax to 400ms if needed during baseline.
- Data residency: critical note — we need EU-resident subset to remain in EU-only processing pipeline. Can Redwood support a per-partition routing policy?

We will aim to deliver a 1,000-record anonymized sample by 3/15. Amit will be the primary technical contact for the sample ingest and network connectivity.

Can we do the recurring Tuesday 10:00am PT status — that works for us.

Also: please send your SOC2 summary and any short network checklist (firewall rules, IP allowlist) we can pass to our security team.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of AI Ops, Aurum Health
Lena.Ortiz@aurumhealth.com

- Priya: please confirm the EU partitioning config we discussed so I can stage a separate endpoint.
- Monica: can you own the credential handoff doc and SFTP ingest checklist? I’ll add you to the Drive folder.
